## User flow

Which flow in `docs/user-flows.md` this change serves, and what the user can now do.

## Acceptance criteria

What must be true for this to be done, and the test that checks each point (unit, story or the feature's spec in `tests/e2e/`).

## Decisions / deviations

Choices made along the way, and anything that departs from `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/design-system.md` or a decision record, with the reason. Add or update an ADR in `docs/decisions/` when a choice is worth keeping.

## A11y / perf

Keyboard and screen-reader behaviour checked, axe in light and dark, reduced motion. Effect on the bundle budgets (`pnpm check:budget`) and on layout shift.

## Review

What a reviewer should look at first, and anything left open.

## Spec reconciliation

Docs updated to match the change (`docs/user-flows.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/design-system.md`, `docs/accessibility.md`), or why none needed to change.
